title: LLD Problem
description: Metadata for one low-level design problem. Every problems/<slug>/meta.json must validate against this. goatengineer.com ingests these directly, so a change here is a breaking change for the platform.

slug.description: Directory name under problems/. Must match the folder it lives in.

title.description: Human-facing name, e.g. 'Design a Parking Lot'.

difficulty.description: Rough sizing for a 60-90 minute machine coding round.

summary.description: One or two sentences. This is the card blurb on goatengineer.com, so it has to stand alone without the full statement.

tags.description: Free-form topic tags used for filtering and search.

patterns.description: Design patterns the reference implementation actually uses. Do not list a pattern the code does not contain.

concepts.description: Non-pattern ideas the problem exercises: concurrency, SOLID principles, data structure choices.

entrypoint.description: Runnable demo, relative to the problem directory.

tests.description: Test directory, relative to the problem directory.

estimatedMinutes.description: How long a candidate should expect to spend implementing this from scratch.

askedAt.description: Companies known to ask this in machine coding rounds. Keep it to ones actually reported, not guesses.

diagram.description: Where the class diagram lives. Mermaid is the source of truth for new problems; the image fields exist for the two originals that predate it.

mermaid.description: True when README.md carries a ```mermaid class diagram.

extensions.description: Follow-up requirements an interviewer is likely to bolt on once the base design works.
